rule: The militia was almost one household. Children keep the cousins, not the statues. Founding-era rights are read through this pew — an endowment, not a grant from a later school.

lens.title: Endowment, not a later catalog
lens.school: Nassau Hall, Princeton. Presidency begins 1768 — the year Ephraim Brevard and Adlai Osborne of this house are listed in Princetonians.

cast.name: Bell
cast.role: Rings the nest. Cousin in the story to Philadelphia’s Liberty Bell.

cast.name: Vee
cast.role: Named for Violet Wilson, whose marriage to Major John Davidson of Rural Hill knits the command family.

cast.name: Lee
cast.role: Named for General William Lee Davidson. Coat too big on purpose. Centre is his other pew.

cast.name: Mary
cast.role: Named for Mary Wilson, who married Ezekiel Polk. Hinge toward James Knox Polk.

cast.name: Isa
cast.role: Named for Isabella Davidson, who married Joseph Graham. Graham is not a guest.

cast.name: Eph
cast.role: Named for Dr. Ephraim Brevard, Princeton 1768, who held the Mecklenburg pen.

cast.name: Adlai
cast.role: Named for Adlai Osborne, Princeton 1768, cousin in this house. Ink for decades.

cast.name: Jo
cast.role: Named for Joseph Graham — sheriff, senator, militia general. Not governor.

cast.name: Will
cast.role: Named for William A. Graham: governor, senator, Navy. The later office sits on Jo’s bench.

cast.name: Knox
cast.role: Named for Captain Patrick Knox. The middle name on a president was already a neighbor.

cast.name: Cal
cast.role: Named for the Caldwell school. Teachers in the blood.

cast.name: Reese
cast.role: Reese of the nest. Copy the name so the pew stays full.

cast.name: Alex
cast.role: Alexander of the nest. The paper and the militia both keep this name.

cast.name: Tom
cast.role: Named for Col. Thomas Polk, tasked to move Philadelphia’s bells to Allentown, 24 September 1777.

cast.name: Horse
cast.role: Rural Hill horse. No lines. Comes home even when the men do not.
